pages.text: $(bold)Mars: The Red Planet$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mars difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mars death}}$()$(br2)Mars is hostile and needs more preparation than the Moon. Its thin atmosphere gives no protection from the extreme cold.

$(bold)Environmental Hazards$()$(br)• $(bold)Cold damage$(): 1 HP every 5 seconds unless your armor carries 3 levels of Thermal Regulation$(br)• $(bold)Hunger$() the whole time: bring extra food or Golden Apples$(br)• Mars mobs have Speed I$(br2)Without a full space suit or MekaSuit you also freeze, 3 HP a second, and Thermal Regulation does not help against that.

$(bold)Purpose$()$(br)Mars has the ores and materials the $(bold)Tier 3 Rocket$() needs to reach Venus and Mercury, Cryogenic Crystals among them. The Martian ruins and underground facilities hold rare loot.$(br2)$(bold)Recommended Gear$()$(br)• A full Space Suit or MekaSuit$(br)• Thermal Regulation on your armor$(br)• High-saturation food supply$(br)• Working RF power for oxygen production

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Mars Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Ferric Oxide$() (30%): heat-resistant compound$(br)• $(bold)Cryogenic Crystal$() (15%): cold-resistant tech$(br)• Redstone (40%)$(br2)The Thermal Pulverizer gives slightly better odds.

$(bold)Thermal Regulation Enchantment$()$(br)Chests on Mars hold books of $(bold)Thermal Regulation$(): level I in 30% of them, level II in 10% (max level 3).$(br2)On armor it takes a third of the cold damage of Mars, Mercury's night and Glacio off per level. Levels on different pieces add up: 3 stop it. It does not stop the freezing you get without a space suit.$(br2)$(bold)Next: crush Mars Stone.$()
